TUR.note: Turkey is the world's #1 wheat-flour exporter (HS1101); milling capacity far exceeds domestic use, fed by large wheat imports for re-export as flour. Balance is flour-equivalent, USDA FAS Turkey grain report 2024 / IGC 2024.

KAZ.note: Kazakhstan is the dominant wheat-flour supplier to Central Asia and Afghanistan; flour exports are strategically critical for regional food security, USDA FAS Kazakhstan 2024 / IGC Grain Market Report 2024.

ITA.note: Italy is the world's #1 pasta exporter (HS1902); pasta dominates its processed-grains surplus, Eurostat Comext 2024.

DEU.note: Germany is a major intra-EU flour and pasta trader; net surplus on flour, net importer of Italian pasta, Eurostat Comext 2024.

FRA.note: France exports wheat flour to West/Central Africa (Angola, Cote d'Ivoire) and trades pasta intra-EU, Eurostat Comext 2024.

ARG.note: Argentina is the top wheat-flour supplier to Brazil and the Andean region under Mercosur, USDA FAS Argentina 2024 / IGC 2024.

BEL.note: Belgium is a re-export hub for flour and pasta to Africa and Latin America via Antwerp, Eurostat Comext 2024.

CAN.note: Canada exports wheat flour and durum pasta to the USA, Japan and Korea, USDA GATS 2024 / Statistics Canada 2024.

USA.note: USA is a large net importer of pasta (mainly Italian) despite sizable flour exports to Mexico and Canada, USDA GATS 2024.

RUS.note: Russia exports wheat flour to the Caucasus and Central Asia (Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Uzbekistan), USDA FAS Russia 2024 / IGC 2024.

UZB.note: Uzbekistan is the largest wheat-flour importer in Central Asia, sourcing overwhelmingly from Kazakhstan and Russia, FAOSTAT 2024 / USDA FAS 2024.

BRA.note: Brazil is the world's largest wheat-flour importer, supplied chiefly by Argentina and Uruguay under Mercosur, FAOSTAT 2024 / USDA FAS Brazil 2024.

AFG.note: Afghanistan depends on imported wheat flour (mainly from Kazakhstan and Pakistan) for basic food security; FAOSTAT does not capture all informal cross-border flour flows, FAO/WFP Afghanistan food security 2024.

IRQ.note: Iraq imports wheat flour from Turkey and the wider region to supplement its public distribution ration, FAO 2024 / USDA FAS 2024.

NLD.note: Netherlands is a Rotterdam-based flour/pasta re-export and import hub; large gross flows both ways, Eurostat Comext 2024.

NGA.note: Nigeria mills imported wheat into flour domestically and tops up with imported flour; representative Sub-Saharan import-dependent market, FAO 2024 / USDA FAS Nigeria 2024.
